run_droprate_sweep: run the droprate_sweep function to generate dropout rate configurations for paper experiments
run_l2reg_sweep: run the l2reg_sweep function to generate L2 regularization parameter configurations for paper experiments
run_network_sweep: run the network_sweep function to generate network architecture configurations with different hidden sizes
run_batch_sweep: run the batch_sweep function to generate batch strategy and number of batches configurations
run_combined_sweep: run the combined_sweep function to generate all dropout sweep configurations combined
